responsibility: This header implements GCC's incremental hashing abstraction on top of iterative jhash-style combination. It provides the inchash::hash accumulator for adding integers, HOST_WIDE_INT values, wide_ints, polynomial integers, pointers, raw memory, boolean flag packs, and commutative subhashes, along with the low-level iterative_hash_* combiners and mixing macro. It is the common hashing utility used when GCC data must be hashed incrementally rather than as one contiguous block.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/inchash.cc, this header contains the actual incremental hashing interface and inline implementation, including inchash::hash and iterative hash combiners, rather than merely supplying a standalone compilation unit.
